content.text:
I didn't book the Launch retro because no room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Why it fails:** Everyone's calendars leave only two 60-minute windows, both on the hour or half hour:
- **09:30–10:30**
- **16:00–17:00**

The only rooms with video conferencing and at least five seats are Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10). None is free in either window:
- **Ember:** Support huddle (09:00–10:30) blocks the morning, and Team lunch (15:00–17:00) blocks the afternoon.
- **Atlas:** Finance sync (09:00–11:00) blocks the morning, and Roadmap review (13:30–17:00) blocks the afternoon.
- **Grove:** Leadership offsite (08:30–17:30) blocks the whole day.

**Options if you want to relax a requirement:**
- **Drop the video requirement:** Cedar (12 seats, north block, storey 3) and Dune (6 seats, north block, storey 1) are free in both windows. Kite (16 seats) is free at 16:00–17:00.
- **Keep video and find another slot:** Juno, Opal and Haven have video but are too small for five people.
- **Use video through a remote link:** Ember, Atlas or Grove could host with a video link if the room is booked for a different time.

Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

I didn't book the meeting. I found no slot where all five attendees are free, a room that seats five, and video conferencing are available on 2026-11-03.

**Why it doesn't work**
- **Attendee availability:** Within working hours (09:00–17:00), all five are free only at 09:30–10:30, 13:00–14:30 and 16:00–17:00.
- **Video-equipped rooms that seat five or more:** Only Ember (6 seats), Atlas (8) and Grove (10) qualify.
- **Room conflicts:**
  - Grove is booked by the Leadership offsite from 08:30 to 17:30.
  - Ember is booked 09:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30 and 15:00–17:00.
  - Atlas is booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00.
  - None of these rooms is free for a full 60 minutes in any of the three common windows. Atlas has only 30 minutes free before 13:30.

**Options for you to decide**
- Drop the video requirement. Kite (16 seats) is free at 09:30–10:30, and Quay (8 seats) is free at 09:30–10:30. Maple (6 seats) is also free at 09:30–10:30 and 16:00–17:00. Any of these would work for the attendees, but none has video conferencing, so the remote stakeholder couldn't join by video.
- Ask one or more attendees to move a meeting. For example, if Ben's or Dev's 10:30 block could shift, the 10:30–11:30 slot in Ember or Atlas might open up. I'd need to check which blocks are movable.
- Use a different date.

I assumed headquarters time is the same as the attendees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC−5). If that's wrong, the availability results could change. Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

Copying LEE-301's address into the survivor and archiving LEE-301 could conflict with whatever that request asks for, such as erasure or restriction. The policy also says exceptions need written approval from the data-governance owner.

**Decision needed:** Please confirm with the data-governance owner how the GDPR request on LEE-301 should be handled. If they confirm the merge can go ahead, I'll copy the address to LEE-377 and archive LEE-301 into it. Otherwise, the request may need to be actioned on LEE-301 before any merge.

I haven't booked the Launch retro, because no room meets all of the requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Who's free:** Everyone is free 09:30–10:30 and 16:00–17:00 (headquarters time, which matches all five calendars). Other free windows are 13:00–14:30 and 13:30–14:30, but those overlap with the people's own commitments in some cases. Each of the 60-minute options fails on rooms.

**Why no room works:** The only rooms with video conferencing and capacity for five are:
- **Ember** (6 seats): booked 09:00–10:30 and 15:00–17:00, and 12:00–13:30.
- **Atlas** (8 seats): booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove** (10 seats): booked all day, 08:30–17:30 (Leadership offsite).

**Options if you're willing to relax a requirement:**
- **Quay** (South, floor 2, 8 seats, projector, no video conferencing) is free 09:30–10:30.
- **Cedar** (North, floor 3, 12 seats, projector and whiteboard, no video conferencing) is also free 09:30–10:30.

Either would work for the 09:30–10:30 slot, but neither has video conferencing, so the remote stakeholder couldn't join by video. Alternatively, the meeting could move to another day, or the remote stakeholder could join by phone or another tool. Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

I couldn't book this meeting. No room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

- **Policy:** External guests must meet on the ground floor (storey 0), and no meeting may overlap the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Capacity:** The room must seat at least 3. The only ground-floor rooms that do are Ember (North) and Maple (South), both with 6 seats.
- **Ember:** Booked 09:30–11:30 (Support huddle) and 14:30–16:00. The only free stretch is 11:30–12:30 or 13:00–14:30, and a 60-minute slot in either would overlap the blackout or fall outside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.
- **Maple:** Booked 09:30–12:00 (weekly partner onboarding) and 13:00–14:30. Its only other free time is after 14:30, which runs past the guest's 15:00 cutoff.

Ana and Ben are both free for a 60-minute slot between 10:00 and 15:00 (Ben has a 13:00–13:30 1:1 and Ana has a 14:30–16:00 roadmap review), so the room is the constraint.

Options if you want to proceed:
- **Ask Facilities for an exception** to the ground-floor rule (facilities@example.com). Dune (North, storey 1, 6 seats) is free all day, so a 10:00–11:00 booking there would work if approved.
- **Ask the Northwind guest for a different time** on the same day. The room options above still don't fit, so this would need a room opening that the current bookings don't have.

content.text:
I didn't book the Launch retro because no room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Availability:** All five are in New York time (UTC-5), which I've treated as headquarters time. Their only 60-minute windows inside working hours that start on the hour or half hour are:
- 09:30–10:30
- 13:00–14:30 (which also fits a 60-minute slot)
- 16:00–17:00

**Rooms:** Only three rooms have video conferencing and seat at least five: Ember, Atlas and Grove. Each is booked during every one of those windows:
- **Ember:** booked 09:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30 and 15:00–17:00.
- **Atlas:** booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove:** booked 08:30–17:30 (Leadership offsite).

**Options if you want me to proceed:**
- **Drop the video requirement.** Dune (6 seats, North floor 1) has no bookings on that day, so it would work at any of the three windows. Remote stakeholders would then need to join another way.
- **Move the meeting to another day.** I can check 2026-11-04 or later for a room with video conferencing.
- **Ask one of the attendees to move a meeting.** Ana's 11:00–13:00 Offsite prep, for example, would open up Ember or Atlas for a different window, but that depends on which of their commitments can move.

A warehouse's available units are its on-hand units minus its reserved units. A transfer must never leave a source warehouse with fewer available units than its safety stock, and reserved units cannot move.

**Attendee availability (all five are on New York time, which matches headquarters, and work 09:00–17:00):** the only windows where everyone is free for 60 minutes are:
- 09:30–10:30
- 13:00–14:00 (or 13:30–14:30)
- 16:00–17:00

**Rooms that seat five and have video conferencing:** only three exist, and each is booked in every one of those windows:
- **Ember** (6 seats, floor 0): Support huddle 09:00–10:30, Hiring panel 12:00–13:30, Team lunch 15:00–17:00.
- **Atlas** (8 seats, floor 2): Finance sync 09:00–11:00, Roadmap review 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove** (10 seats, floor 3): Leadership offsite 08:30–17:30 all day.

**Options if you want me to proceed:**
- **Drop the video requirement:** Lark (5 seats, floor 2 South) is free at 13:00–14:00 and 16:00–17:00. Dune (6 seats, floor 1 North) is free all day. Quay (8 seats) is free at 09:30–10:30. Kite (16 seats) is free at 13:00–14:00.
- **Keep video and move the remote stakeholder to a phone or other dial-in:** Ember, Atlas or Grove would then be the only candidates, but they are all occupied in the windows above, so this still doesn't work without moving existing bookings.
- **Keep video and ask whether one of the existing bookings can move:** for example, Ember's Support huddle ends at 10:30, so moving it would open 09:30–10:30 there.

Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

I haven't made any changes. CRM-2044 carries a `gdpr_request` label, and I want you to confirm before I merge it.

**The two matching records (same name and date of birth 1989-03-14):**
- **CRM-2001** (survivor, opened 2023-02-11)
- **CRM-2044** (duplicate, opened 2025-01-09)

**Field winners under policy MP-2026-1 (most recent verification wins):**
- **Email:** `priya.r.raman@example.org` from CRM-2044 (confirmed 2026-07-03, versus 2025-04-02 on CRM-2001).
- **Phone:** `+44 7700 900123` from CRM-2001 (confirmed 2026-08-15, versus 2026-02-10 on CRM-2044). No change needed.
- **Address:** `9 Kestrel Court, York` from CRM-2044 (confirmed 2026-09-12, versus 2024-06-20 on CRM-2001).

**Why I stopped:** The merge would copy CRM-2044's email and address onto the surviving record, CRM-2001, and then archive CRM-2044. The policy has no rule for records under a GDPR request, and its remarks say exceptions need written approval from the data-governance owner. Copying that record's personal data into another record could conflict with the request. Please confirm with data governance whether the merge can go ahead. If it can, I'll update CRM-2001's email to `priya.r.raman@example.org` and address to `9 Kestrel Court, York`, then archive CRM-2044 with `merged_into` set to CRM-2001.

content.text:
I didn't book the meeting. No room meets all of the requirements at a time when all five attendees are free.

**Why it doesn't work:**
- Only three rooms both seat five or more and have video conferencing: **Ember** (6), **Atlas** (8) and **Grove** (10).
- Grove is booked by the Leadership offsite all day (08:30–17:30).
- Ember has a Support huddle 09:00–10:30 and Team lunch 15:00–17:00.
- Atlas has a Finance sync 09:00–11:00 and a Roadmap review 13:30–17:00.
- The attendees' calendars leave only two free 60-minute windows, both of which clash with one of those bookings:
  - **09:30–10:30**, which overlaps the Finance sync in Atlas and the Support huddle in Ember.
  - **16:00–17:00**, which overlaps the Roadmap review in Atlas and Team lunch in Ember.

I've assumed headquarters time is America/New_York, the zone all five calendars use.

**Options if you want to relax a requirement:**
- Drop video conferencing. These rooms are free for at least one of the two windows:
  - **Dune** (6 seats, whiteboard), free both windows.
  - **Cedar** (12 seats, projector and whiteboard), free both windows.
  - **Maple** (6 seats, projector), free both windows.
  - **Quay** (8 seats, projector), free 09:30–10:30 only.
- Keep video conferencing by moving the meeting. Ember or Atlas could work if the Support huddle, Finance sync or Roadmap review were moved, or if the meeting were held on another day.

Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

I didn't book the meeting because no room meets all of your requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Why it can't be booked:** All five attendees are in the America/New_York time zone (UTC-5), which I took as headquarters time, and their combined calendars leave only two free 60-minute windows within 09:00–17:00:
- **09:30–10:30**
- **16:00–17:00**

The only rooms with video conferencing and capacity for five are Ember, Atlas and Grove, and each is already booked in both windows:
- **Ember (6 seats):** Support huddle 09:00–10:30 and Team lunch 15:00–17:00.
- **Atlas (8 seats):** Finance sync 09:00–11:00 and Roadmap review 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove (10 seats):** Leadership offsite 08:30–17:30.

**Options if you want to proceed:**
1. **Drop the video requirement.** Dune (6 seats, North floor 1) is free all day, so it could take the meeting at 09:30–10:30 or 16:00–17:00. Your remote stakeholder would need to join another way.
2. **Move the meeting to another day** where a video-equipped room is free. I can check that.
3. **Ask the attendees to shift their busy blocks**, such as moving Ana's, Ben's or Chloe's 14:30–16:00 meeting, which would open up more slots.

Tell me which option you prefer and I'll book it.

I didn't book the meeting. No room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Availability:** Working hours are 09:00–17:00 for all five, and their calendars are on New York time, which I took as headquarters time. The only slots when all five are free for 60 minutes are **09:30–10:30** and **16:00–17:00**.

**Rooms:** Only three rooms have video conferencing and seat at least five: Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10). All three are already booked in both slots:
- **Ember:** Support huddle 09:00–10:30 and Team lunch 15:00–17:00.
- **Atlas:** Finance sync 09:00–11:00 and Roadmap review 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove:** Leadership offsite 08:30–17:30.

**Options if you relax the video requirement:** These rooms seat at least five and are free at 09:30–10:30 (Dune, Cedar and Maple also have no conflicting booking at 16:00–17:00 or in that slot, but Quay is booked from 15:30):
- **Dune** (North, storey 1, 6 seats, whiteboard)
- **Cedar** (North, storey 3, 12 seats, projector and whiteboard)
- **Quay** (South, storey 2, 8 seats, projector)
- **Maple** (South, storey 0, 6 seats, projector)

Tell me which slot and room you'd like, or whether another date would work better, and I'll book it. The remote stakeholder would need another way to join if you choose one of these rooms.

I did not book the meeting. No room meets all the requirements at any time that works for all five attendees on 2026-11-03.

**Availability:** All five are on New York time (UTC-5), which I took to be headquarters time. Their common free windows, within 09:00–17:00, are:
- 09:30–10:30
- 13:00–14:30
- 16:00–17:00

That allows 60-minute starts at 09:30, 13:00, 13:30 or 16:00.

**Rooms:** Only three rooms have video conferencing and seat at least five: Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10).
- **Ember** is booked 09:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30 and 15:00–17:00, so it conflicts with every candidate start.
- **Atlas** is booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00, so it conflicts with every candidate start.
- **Grove** is booked for the leadership offsite 08:30–17:30.

**Options for you to choose from:** Each of these fits all five attendees, but none has video conferencing, so the remote stakeholder would need another way to join:
- **Dune** (6 seats, whiteboard, North floor 1): free all day.
- **Maple** (6 seats, projector, South floor 0): free at 09:30 and 16:00.
- **Quay** (8 seats, projector, South floor 2): free at 09:30.
- **Kite** (16 seats, projector, South floor 3): free at 16:00.

If you want video, the meeting could move to a day when Ember, Atlas or Grove is free, or the attendees' schedules could change. Tell me which option you prefer and I'll book it.
